The three pie charts in the image represent the state of enterprises, employment, and turnover by industry in 2021. The first chart shows the number of enterprises by industry breakdown as industry (61%), construction (19%), trade (12%), and other services (8%). The second chart shows the distribution of the number of persons employed by industry as industry (21%), construction (9%), trade (19%), and other services (51%). The third chart shows the turnover by industry breakdown as industry (33%), construction (6%), trade (31%), and other services (31%). 

The data is sourced from Eurostat.
